name: Apothic Red 2022
proNotes: A smooth and approachable red blend featuring dark fruit flavors of blackberry and plum with hints of mocha and vanilla from oak aging. The wine offers a velvety mouthfeel with soft tannins and a touch of sweetness that makes it very accessible to casual wine drinkers.

name: Barons Creek Vineyards Celebration 2025
proNotes: This appears to be a white wine from Barons Creek Vineyards with a 2025 vintage, which would be a future release. Without being able to clearly identify the specific grape variety or having detailed knowledge of this particular producer, it's difficult to provide accurate tasting notes.

name: Barons Creek Opulent Red Blend
proNotes: This red blend typically showcases rich dark fruit flavors with notes of blackberry, plum, and hints of vanilla from oak aging. The wine offers a full-bodied structure with smooth tannins and a lingering finish with subtle spice notes.

name: Cooper & Thief Red Wine Blend 2022
proNotes: This innovative red blend is aged for 3 months in bourbon barrels, creating a unique fusion of wine and whiskey characteristics. The bourbon barrel aging imparts vanilla, caramel, and spice notes that complement the dark fruit flavors of the blend. The wine exhibits a rich, full-bodied structure with smooth tannins and a distinctive finish that bridges wine and spirits.

name: Josh Cellars Pinot Grigio California Vintner's Edition
proNotes: A crisp and refreshing Pinot Grigio with bright acidity and clean citrus flavors. Aromas of green apple, pear, and subtle floral notes lead to a light-bodied palate with zesty lime and stone fruit characteristics. The wine finishes clean and dry, making it an excellent everyday drinking option.

name: Sonoma-Cutrer Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024
proNotes: This Sonoma Coast Chardonnay displays bright citrus and green apple flavors with subtle oak integration and refreshing acidity. The cool coastal climate imparts crisp minerality and elegant structure. Clean finish with hints of vanilla and a touch of tropical fruit.

name: 1000 Stories Bourbon Barrel-Aged Zinfandel 2022
proNotes: This bourbon barrel-aged Zinfandel showcases rich jammy blackberry and dark cherry flavors with distinctive vanilla, caramel, and toasted oak notes from the bourbon barrel aging. The wine offers a full-bodied structure with smooth tannins and a long, warm finish that balances the fruit intensity with bourbon-derived spice and sweetness.

name: Black Tie A Dry Red Wine
proNotes: This is a value-oriented California red blend designed for everyday drinking. It typically offers approachable flavors of dark berries, plum, and subtle spice with soft tannins and medium body. The wine is crafted for easy drinking with a smooth, fruit-forward profile.

name: Apothic Inferno Whiskey Barrel-Aged Red Blend
proNotes: This whiskey barrel-aged red blend offers bold flavors of dark fruit, vanilla, and spice from the barrel aging process. The wine combines rich blackberry and plum notes with smoky undertones and a hint of caramel sweetness. The whiskey barrel aging adds complexity with oak tannins and a warming finish.

name: Josh Cellars Legacy Red Blend
proNotes: This California red blend offers approachable flavors of dark berries, plum, and subtle spice with soft tannins. The wine typically combines varietals like Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Petite Sirah to create a smooth, medium-bodied wine with notes of vanilla and chocolate from oak aging.

name: La Crema Monterey Chardonnay 2023
proNotes: This Monterey Chardonnay displays bright citrus and green apple flavors with subtle tropical fruit notes and a hint of minerality from the cool coastal climate. The wine offers crisp acidity with light oak influence, creating a balanced and food-friendly style. Clean finish with notes of lemon zest and white flowers.

name: Pine Ridge Chenin Blanc + Viognier 2024
proNotes: This white blend combines the crisp acidity and green apple notes of Chenin Blanc with the floral aromatics and stone fruit character of Viognier. The wine offers bright citrus flavors, hints of honeysuckle, and a clean, refreshing finish with good minerality.
